header: Reading a printed check-up date ("01-01-25", "13.01.2025") and judging it against the month the circular says it schedules. I guess nothing silently: a date whose YEAR is plainly wrong for its schedule is corrected only when day and month are consistent, and I record the correction; a date that does not fit at all is reported, never stored as if it were fine.

symbols.name: parsePrintedDate
symbols.sig: export function parsePrintedDate(text: string): ParsedDate | null
doc: Reads "01-01-25", "13.01.2025", "13/01/2025", "010125" as day, month, year. Null when it is not a calendar date.

symbols.name: parseScheduleMonth
symbols.sig: export function parseScheduleMonth(text: string): { month: number; year: number } | null
doc: Reads the month a roster schedules from its title: "...FOR THE MONTH OF JANNUARY 2025", "...DECEMBER 2024", "...MONTH OF JAN-2026".

symbols.name: repairPrintedDate
symbols.sig: export function repairPrintedDate(printed: string, schedule: { month: number; year: number } | null): { date: string; note: string } | null
doc: Handles a printed date that is not a calendar date ("11/012/25": a stray digit in the circular itself). I read it only when removing ONE digit gives exactly ONE date that fits the schedule's month and year; otherwise it stays unread. Returns null when there is no such reading.
